senses.gloss: m. (γῆ κρητική, creta) chalk, white earth used for cleansing silver ware.
units: Sabb. 50ᵃ גרתי׳ Ar. (ed. גרתקון, גרתקין); Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ bot. קרטי׳; Tosef. Bets. IV, 10 קירטון ed. Zuck. (Var. קרקתין, קרתתין). [Rashi to Sabb. l. c. expl. אלום, describing tartar deposited in wine vessels; Ar.: pulverised resin.]
